programme.title: Mechanics of Love
programme.desc: Mattie, a tech entrepreneur who is home for her sisters wedding runs into Jake, a childhood friend who complicates her life.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: In this romantic tearjerker, an angst-ridden doctor (Lisa Hartman Black) returns home to attend a high-school reunion---and to mend fences with loved ones she left behind. Helen: Rue McClanahan. Gus: Dale Midkiff. Nelson: Larry Manetti.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: An aspiring screenwriter pretends to date a starlet who's trying to make her ex jealous. As the duo keep up their ruse, the lines between fact and fiction begin to blur and romantic entanglements ensue.

programme.title: Captains Courageous
programme.desc: Rudyard Kipling's tale about a spoiled heir (Kenny Vadas) who learns the value of friendship and work when he's rescued at sea by fishermen and forced to earn his keep. Capt. Troop: Robert Urich. Dan: Kaj-Erik Eriksen. Wade: Robert Wisden. Mrs. Troop: Sandra Nelson. Michael Anderson directed.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.title: The Cookie Mobster
programme.desc: A young mob member goes into the Witness Protection Program and settles into a quiet suburban village, where he falls for a local woman and gets involved with cookie-making fund-raising for her daughter's scout troop while dodging his former associates who have tracked him down.

programme.title: Diagnosis Delicious
programme.desc: A disgraced chef and an ambitious cardiologist who can't even boil water cross paths when she takes his cooking class. Now she must convince the hot-headed chef to teach her hospital's new Healthy Living seminars, but he has another idea.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie MacKenzie is a dedicated career woman who must lie about having a family in order to land her dream job. Charlie gets the job, but when her new boss moves in next door, Charlie must hire an actor to play her husband and borrow her best friend's teenage daughter to act as her own child.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Legally Tender
programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: Love Will Keep Us Together
programme.desc: After years of hiring housekeepers to run his home, a single advertising executive loses his job and becomes a stay-at-home dad. His new role gives him a different perspective on his family, but a tempting job offer threatens to lead him back to his old workaholic ways.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.title: A View from Here
programme.desc: A journalist (Laura Leighton) returns to her rural hometown to visit her ailing mother (Angie Dickinson) and discovers that many of the area's farmers are selling their land to a casino developer because of an extreme drought. Directed by Stephen W. Bridgewater.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Reluctant Nanny
programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: A man and a woman agree to meet after hitting it off on a phone call, but they keep missing each other for various reasons.

programme.title: Win, Lose or Love
programme.desc: A single mom and a widowed dad tie for the presidency of the PTA at their children's elementary school, where they engage in a power struggle and eventually realize they have feelings for each other.

programme.title: Bound & Babysitting
programme.desc: A couple need a babysitter so they can go on a much-needed romantic getaway, so they enlist the help of two friends who have been enemies since college in hopes that they realize how much they have in common.

programme.title: Love Takes Wing
programme.desc: A young doctor (Sarah Jones) moves to a town where a strange illness has stricken several residents, particularly those in the local orphanage. Despite their peril, the townspeople resist her efforts to help because she's a woman, so the doctor must find a way to save the town before it's too late. Haylie Duff, Cloris Leachman, Patrick Duffy. Directed by Lou Diamond Phillips, who also stars. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Sentimental tale of a proud widow (Ann-Margret) whose deteriorating sight impels her to take in a drifter (Matthew Settle) and his precocious daughter (Shailene Woodley). Gary Sandy, Hunter Tylo. Jan Kyles: Rebecca McFarland. Dave Jeeters: Sean O'Bryan. Sheriff Gorman: Christopher Murray.

programme.title: Hometown Hero
programme.desc: Romance develops when a cynical divorce mediator has to take care of a client's dog.

programme.title: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: An aspiring screenwriter pretends to date a starlet who's trying to make her ex jealous. As the duo keep up their ruse, the lines between fact and fiction begin to blur and romantic entanglements ensue.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Sweet Surrender
programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: The Nanny Express
programme.desc: A spunky nanny (Vanessa Marcil) tries to win over her rebellious charges, who are coping with the death of their mother. Romance soon blooms between the nanny and the kids' father (Brennan Elliott), but the relationship could stall if the kids object. Dean Stockwell and Stacy Keach also star.

programme.title: Bound by a Secret
programme.desc: Dying actress Jane (Leslie Ann Warren) returns to her hometown to spend her final days with her best friend, Ida Mae (Meredith Baxter). Their respite hits a snag, though, when Jane decides to reveal that she's the biological mother of Ida Mae's daughter (Bridget Ann White). Timothy Bottoms also stars. Directed by David S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: How Not to Propose

programme.title: Secret Summer
programme.desc: Rachel, a NYC appraiser is sent to a small town to buy out a library so her client can build a resort. She meets Jake, a local writer who tries to convince her how important the library is to the small community but the arrival of his niece and nephew complicate his efforts.

programme.title: Oliver's Ghost
programme.desc: A young boy (Nicholas Stargel) befriends a ghost (Martin Mull) living in the attic of his family's new house in a small town. After several angry outbursts from the ghost, the boy tries to get to the bottom of what's plaguing him. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.desc: A manicurist predicts that an unlucky-at-love lawyer will meet the love of her life and he will be a Michael, so the attorney begins a series of dates with men with that name.

programme.title: Return to Sender
programme.desc: When a weathered old envelope appears in the mailbox of Meg's new apartment marked Return to Sender, she joins the building manager Ollie along with podcaster Ellen and partner Pete to find out who sent this mysterious love letter.

programme.title: Relative Stranger
programme.desc: After the death of his father, a former football hero who abandoned his family returns home after six years. His mother tries to mediate the conflict stirred up by his return as he faces his wife and children, whom he left behind.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Avalanche visit the Stars for Game 1 of their first-round series. Dallas ended the regular season on a seven-game slide. Colorado's Nathan MacKinnon shared the NHL lead with 84 assists. The Stars eliminated the Avs in the West semifinals in 2024.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The injury-depleted Stars try to tie up their first-round series with the Avalanche entering Game 2. Without key players Jason Robertson and Miro Heiskanen, Dallas couldn't stop Colorado's attack in Game 1, falling 5-1. Nathan MacKinnon scored twice.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The rejuvenated Stars visit the Avalanche for Game 3 of their West quarterfinal. Dallas evened the series 1-1 with a 4-3 victory in Game 2 on Colin Blackwell's goal at 17:46 of overtime. Nathan MacKinnon (COL) has tallied three times this series.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Stars visit the Avalanche for Game 4 of a West quarterfinal. Colorado's Gabriel Landeskog played for the first time since June 26, 2022, but Dallas spoiled the party on Tyler Seguin's goal at 5:31 of overtime in Game 3 to take a 2-1 series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: Gabriel Landeskog's Avalanche visit the Stars for a pivotal Game 5 of their Western Conference quarterfinal. Landeskog recorded a goal and an assist, and Mackenzie Blackwood made 23 saves as Colorado evened the series with a 4-0 victory in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Avalanche try to stay alive as they return to the Rockies for Game 6 of their West first-round set with the Stars. Wyatt Johnston scored nine seconds into Game 5, finishing with two goals and an assist as Dallas rolled to a 6-2 decision.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Avalanche visit the Stars for Game 7 of their West quarterfinal series. Colorado forced a deciding showdown with a 7-4 victory in Game 6 behind Nathan MacKinnon's go-ahead goal in the third period. Dallas coach Peter DeBoer is 8-0 in Game 7s.

programme.desc: The Maple Leafs and Senators engage in another Battle of Ontario in Game 1 of an East first-round set. This is just the third time both have made the playoffs simultaneously since four meetings in five postseasons from 2000-2004, all won by Toronto.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs host the Senators for Game 2 of their Eastern Conference quarterfinal. Mitch Marner had three points and Anthony Stolarz collected his first postseason victory as Toronto took a 1-0 series lead with a 6-2 decision in Game 1.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs try to put a stranglehold on their East first-round series with the Senators in Game 3. Max Domi ripped the overtime winner just over three minutes into the first extra frame of Game 2 to give Toronto a 3-2 win, and a 2-0 series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Maple Leafs look to swiftly end the Senators' playoff return, up 3-0 in Game 4 of their first-round set. Simon Benoit, who scored six goals in his first 288 NHL games, slapped home the overtime winner in Toronto's 3-2 Game 3 victory over Ottawa.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Ottawa Senators at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: The Senators try to continue their comeback in Game 5 of their first-round set with the Maple Leafs. Jake Sanderson saved Ottawa's season and prevented a third straight overtime loss when the defenseman scored in a 4-3 win over Toronto in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.sub-title: Toronto Maple Leafs at Ottawa Senators
programme.desc: The Senators continue a comeback attempt as they host the Maple Leafs in Game 6 of an East quarterfinal. Linus Ullmark made 29 saves as Ottawa blanked Toronto 4-0 in Game 5 to stay alive. Tim Stützle notched a goal and two assists for the Sens.
